
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/DashVector/p/19214346" title="发布于 2025-11-12 15:50">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">如何通过Python SDK更新Collection中已存在的Doc</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文介绍如何通过Python SDK更新Collection中已存在的Doc。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>本文介绍如何通过Python SDK更新Collection中已存在的Doc。</p>
<p><strong>说明</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>若更新Doc时指定id不存在，则本次更新Doc操作无效</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>如只更新部分属性fields，其他未更新属性fields默认被置为<code>None</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Python SDK 1.0.11版本后，更新Doc时vector变为非必填项</strong></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="前提条件">前提条件</h2>
<ul>
<li>已创建Cluster</li>
<li>已获得API-KEY</li>
<li>已安装最新版SDK</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="接口定义"><strong>接口定义</strong></h2>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">Collection.update(
    docs: Union[Doc, List[Doc], Tuple, List[Tuple]],
    partition: Optional[str] = None,
    async_req: False
) -&gt; DashVectorResponse
</code></pre>
<h2 id="使用示例"><strong>使用示例</strong></h2>
<p><strong>说明</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>需要使用您的api-key替换示例中的YOUR_API_KEY、您的Cluster Endpoint替换示例中的YOUR_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT，代码才能正常运行。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>本示例需要参考<a href="https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2510242.html#hivl6" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">新建Collection-使用示例</a>提前创建好名称为<code>quickstart</code>的Collection。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">import dashvector
from dashvector import Doc
import numpy as np

client = dashvector.Client(
    api_key='YOUR_API_KEY',
    endpoint='YOUR_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT'
)
collection = client.get(name='quickstart')
</code></pre>
<h3 id="更新doc"><strong>更新Doc</strong></h3>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 通过Doc对象update
ret = collection.update(
    Doc(
        id='1',
        vector=[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]
    )
)
# 判断update是否成功
assert ret

# 简化形式：通过Tuple update
ret = collection.update(
    ('2', [0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1])               # (id, vector)
)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="更新带有fields的doc">更新带有Fields的Doc</h3>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># update单条数据，并设置Fields Value
ret = collection.update(
    Doc(
        id='3',
        vector=np.random.rand(4),
        fields={
            # 设置创建Collection时预定义的Fields Value
            'name': 'zhangsan', 'weight':70.0, 'age':30, 
            # 设置Schema-Free的Field &amp; Value
            'anykey1': 'str-value', 'anykey2': 1,
            'anykey3': True, 'anykey4': 3.1415926
        }
    )
)

# update单条数据，并设置Fields Value
ret = collection.update(
    ('4', np.random.rand(4), {'foo': 'bar'})  # (id, vector, fields)
)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="批量更新doc"><strong>批量更新Doc</strong></h3>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 通过Doc对象，批量update 10条数据
ret = collection.update(
    [
        Doc(id=str(i+5), vector=np.random.rand(4)) for i in range(10)
    ]
)

# 简化形式：通过Tuple，批量update 3条数据
ret = collection.update(
    [
        ('15', [0.2,0.7,0.8,1.3], {'age': 20}),
        ('16', [0.3,0.6,0.9,1.2], {'age': 30}),
        ('17', [0.4,0.5,1.0,1.1], {'age': 40})
    ]                                         # List[(id, vector, fields)]
)

# 判断批量update是否成功
assert ret
</code></pre>
<h3 id="异步更新doc">异步更新Doc</h3>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 异步批量update 10条数据
ret_funture = collection.update(
    [
        Doc(id=str(i+18), vector=np.random.rand(4), fields={'name': 'foo' + str(i)}) for i in range(10)
    ],
    async_req=True
)
# 等待并获取异步update结果
ret = ret_funture.get()
</code></pre>
<h3 id="更新带有sparse-vector的doc"><strong>更新带有Sparse Vector的Doc</strong></h3>
<p>Python示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">ret = collection.update(
    Doc(
        id='28',
        vector=[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4],
        sparse_vector={1:0.4, 10000:0.6, 222222:0.8}
    )
)
</code></pre>

</div>
